description: A 1-wide part on the example fit profile: pinDiameter -0.10 mm (pin cell 4.70 on the Technic pin row) makes the solid pin 3.08 mm instead of its 3.18 mm nominal, and no coupon cell tests that pin: warning.

findings.fix: print the part once and check how its pin holds between studs; if it is too loose or too tight, move pinDiameter in fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` towards 0 (it also sizes Technic pins)
findings.message: the solid pin under the 1-wide part is 3.08 mm after offsets, 0.1 mm under its 3.18 mm nominal: the pinDiameter offset of fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` is calibrated on coupon cell `pin` (Technic pins (male), outer diameter, 4.65 to 4.9 mm), and no coupon cell tests the solid pin, so no printed cell has shown how it grips

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
